events.label: Beau Lamarre-Condon trial hears triple-zero call and testimony

slots.name: defendant age
slots.sentence: Lamarre-Condon, 31, has been accused of fatally shooting Davies and Baird with his police service weapon in Baird’s Paddington home on 19 February 2024.

slots.name: plea status
slots.sentence: He has pleaded not guilty to two counts of murder and one charge of aggravated break and enter.

slots.name: trial status
slots.sentence: The trial before justice Natalie Adams continues.

slots.name: emergency call time
slots.sentence: Crown prosecutor Brett Hatfield SC told the court a call had been made to the emergency line from Davies’ phone at 9.50am on Friday 19 February 2024.
